name: Doharas Happiness
source:
Doharas Happiness is the President and founder of Happiness Pharmaceutical and the creator of the universally-used healing medicine Seirogan. He lives in the main Happiness Pharmaceuticals factory building in the Free City of Ice with his young daughter Eline. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Doharas_Happiness]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
